name: dshd-jobs
description: Deepartments agenda/jobs engine: the pure cron scheduler (parseCronSchedule/cronMatches/nextCronFire/cronIsDue), the job-definition reader (parseJobDefFrontmatter/jobDirFor/readJobDefinitionFile/readAgendaJobs), the calendar + job-runs state store helpers (read/write calendar.json + job-runs-state.json) and the pure scheduler tick runAgendaSchedulerTick — extracted for the dshd-jobs phase of the modular Cordis split. A pure library package (NO cordis plugin, NO tool, NO patch): the bundle consumes it through the drop-in bridge src/core/jobs.ts.
